tv_test_trigger_block = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
				building_efficiency = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_labor_camp value >= 0.9 }
			}
		}
		value = 0.9
	}
}

tv_test_quoted_numeric_read = {
	set_variable = {
		name = tv_wonder_labor_camp_efficiency
		value = "var:tv_wonder_site.building_efficiency(building_type:tv_wonder_labor_camp)"
	}
}
